critic.evidence: Attempt 1 (hist_gbdt, class_weight='balanced') scored balanced_accuracy 0.8446 (95% CI 0.8361~0.8521) against the bar 0.9189 — a shortfall of 0.0743. The gap is not in the operating point: recall 0.8554 vs specificity 0.8338 are nearly equal, balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut is 0.8457 and cut_headroom is only 0.0011, i.e. 1.5% of the 0.0743 still needed; the other 98.5% is in the ranking (roc_auc 0.9293, pr_auc 0.8302, implied KS ~0.6914 vs the required 0.8378). Capacity/overfit is not the story either: train_balanced_accuracy 0.8829 vs val 0.8446, train_val_gap 0.0383, and early stopping fired on its own at iter 323/600, so more iterations or looser regularisation is not the missing piece. Cost is a non-issue (train_time_sec 10.5, no dropped_hyperparams, status ok). The bar itself sits above what any single family off this list has been shown to cover: the recorded ranking-axis span for swapping tree family under an unchanged pipeline is 0.0022~0.0077 roc_auc, roughly a tenth of the 0.0743 still required, and feature construction is unavailable (unsupported_claims: feature_engineering). So the shortfall is a ranking shortfall the available levers cannot close; the honest reading is the family/feature axis, and the most informative remaining spend is the one untried strong ranking generator plus the only column-adding lever the executor has.
critic.direction: Spend the next attempt on the ranking axis alone by swapping to xgboost (the untried strong ranker that also splits on NaN natively) with a slightly deeper, lower-learning-rate configuration and early stopping, leaving preprocessing exactly as attempt 1 (impute none, no scaling, no indicator columns) so the row is attributable to the family swap — and note in advance that with the ranking-axis span for family swaps at 0.0022~0.0077 roc_auc against a 0.0743 shortfall, this is diagnostic of the ceiling rather than a plan that reaches 0.9189.
